_source: Every visible string on the page. From the structure and copy in the Perplexity brief Jason supplied on 3 October 2026, with his corrections the same day: first fight 7:10 pm, no fight card, no fourth fight, instant confirmation and air conditioning confirmed, the words official and limited kept. Nothing is typed anywhere else. gen.mjs reads this file and stops if a key is missing.

items.name: Petchsila Wor. Auracha
items.title: Rajadamnern Super Bantamweight champion
items.text: A Thai southpaw and proven stadium-level champion. Petchsila enters as the home champion against Japanese RISE titleholder Koki Osaki.

items.name: Koki Osaki
items.title: Japanese RISE Bantamweight champion
items.text: One of Japan’s leading lighter-weight fighters, Osaki arrives with proven success in RWS rules and an interim Super Bantamweight title.

items.name: Egor Bikrev
items.title: Rajadamnern Lightweight champion
items.text: The Russian champion made history by winning the title with the fastest knockout in RWS history. He now defends against former RISE champion Kan Nakamura.

items.name: Kan Nakamura
items.title: Former RISE Lightweight champion
items.text: A high-output Japanese contender with a strong knockout record and a dangerous knee-strike game.

expect: Arrive early for security and to find your seats.
Dress is casual. The stadium is air-conditioned.

confidence.body: Choose your seat, complete secure checkout and receive your booking confirmation straight away. We are here to help if you need support before the event.

items.a: The official stadium allocation has sold out. MuayTix has a limited number of pre-secured tickets while availability lasts.
Gates open at 6:00 pm. We recommend arriving early so you have time for entry and to find your seat before the fights begin at 7:10 pm.
The event takes place at Rajadamnern Stadium in Bangkok.
Club Class is the best all-round choice for many first-time guests. Use the Rajadamnern seating guide to compare every category.

items.q: Will I receive my ticket immediately?
items.a: As soon as you pay, you receive instant confirmation of your payment and your booking.
